fit_reason: Whole 2004 Toyota Sequoia SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Black paint looks dull and dusty rather than glossy on the hood and front fenders in the front shots
Unpainted black front bumper and lower trim look faded and grayish
Headlight lenses appear slightly hazy and yellowed
Dust and road film visible along the lower doors and rocker area on the driver side
Several photos are taken at dusk and in shade, which limits detail on paint condition; no interior photos shown
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Sequoia. The black paint on the hood looks a bit dull, and the front bumper trim and headlights have faded some, which a buff, trim restoration and headlight polish would really freshen up for photos. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you before the weekend. Would you like a quote?
